notes: Invoice, bank statement, ledger entry, and receipt all share consistent vendor (GreenRoute Logistics Pvt. Ltd.), amount (59000.0 INR), and cross-references to INV-1005. Bank settlement (2026-08-18) and ledger entry (same date) align with the invoice payment. However, both the invoice and receipt reference PO-1005, which was never supplied - its absence cannot be assumed to be expected/PO-exempt since the documents themselves point to its existence, so it is flagged as missing. Additionally, the receipt's completion date (2026-07-18) precedes the invoice date (2026-07-21), an unusual sequence that internal consistency of amounts/vendor does not resolve or excuse. Successful bank settlement confirms payment occurred but does not itself substitute for the missing PO or validate the order-to-receipt timing.
